name: Money Fixed Margin
summary: This EA is a money management utility that calculates lot size based on a fixed margin amount per trade. It does not generate trading signals or open positions on its own; instead, it serves as a position sizing helper for other EAs or manual trading by determining the appropriate volume given a predefined margin risk.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个资金管理工具，根据每笔交易的固定保证金金额计算手数。它不自行生成交易信号或开仓，而是作为仓位规模辅助工具，根据预定义的保证金风险为其他EA或手动交易确定合适的交易量。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心概念是固定保证金资金管理，即每笔交易只承担固定金额的保证金风险。入场条件并非由该EA自身决定，它依赖外部信号或手动操作来触发交易。出场条件同样不由该EA控制。仓位管理是其核心功能，通过将预设的固定保证金除以当前品种的每手保证金需求来计算交易手数，确保每笔交易的保证金暴露一致。资金管理方面，它将风险量化为固定保证金而非固定手数或固定百分比，这是一种较为直观的风险控制方式。该EA属于辅助工具类别，不包含独立的交易策略逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is fixed margin money management, where each trade risks only a predetermined fixed margin amount. Entry conditions are not determined by this EA itself; it relies on external signals or manual operations to trigger trades. Exit conditions are likewise not controlled by this EA. Position sizing is its core function, calculating the trade volume by dividing the preset fixed margin by the per-lot margin requirement of the current instrument, ensuring consistent margin exposure per trade. In terms of money management, it quantifies risk as a fixed margin rather than a fixed lot size or percentage, which is a relatively intuitive risk control approach. This EA falls into the utility category and does not contain independent trading strategy logic.

parameters.name: FixedMargin
parameters.description: 每笔交易使用的固定保证金金额（货币单位）
parameters.description_en: Fixed margin amount per trade in account currency

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术编号，用于标识EA订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number to identify EA positions, 0 for all positions

pros: 固定保证金方式使每笔交易的风险暴露保持一致，便于风险控制
计算逻辑简单直观，易于理解和使用
可作为其他EA的辅助模块，提升整体资金管理能力
pros_en: Fixed margin approach keeps risk exposure consistent per trade, facilitating risk control
Simple and intuitive calculation logic, easy to understand and use
Can serve as an auxiliary module for other EAs, improving overall money management capability
cons: 仅基于保证金计算手数，未考虑止损距离和市场波动性，可能导致实际风险不对等
缺乏独立交易信号，必须配合其他策略或手动操作使用
没有考虑账户杠杆变化和不同品种保证金比例差异的影响
cons_en: Lot sizing based solely on margin without considering stop-loss distance and market volatility may lead to unequal actual risk
Lacks independent trading signals and must be used in conjunction with other strategies or manual operations
Does not account for account leverage changes and differences in margin ratio across instruments
improvements: 增加基于ATR或止损距离的动态手数计算选项，使风险控制更加精确
加入账户余额百分比的仓位计算模式，提供更灵活的资金管理选择
improvements_en: Add dynamic lot calculation options based on ATR or stop-loss distance for more precise risk control
Incorporate account balance percentage position sizing mode for more flexible money management options

risk_points: 作为工具类EA，本身不执行交易，风险极低
如果配合无止损的策略使用，固定保证金可能无法有效控制实际亏损
risk_points_en: As a utility EA that does not execute trades itself, the inherent risk is extremely low
When used with strategies that have no stop-loss, fixed margin may not effectively control actual losses
